text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of Каррен Тян's
second
summer camp, and it's time to
prepare for the
biggest race of her
career—the Sprinters Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since she's coming off of a very busy
schedule, I
ask how she's doing. In
response, she coyly says
that she got
through it due to my love for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
